description: ParisPenthouse. Fr 400 SQM Luxury by the Eiffel TowerParisPenthouse. Fr - is one of Paris’ most exclusive homes represented by Seychelles Travel Ltd. Steps from the Eiffel Tower, River Seine & the Champs-Élysées. On the prestigious Avenue de la Bourdonnais, this 400 sqm home blends Parisian charm with luxury hotel comfort. Ideal for families seeking abcity escape.The spaceLive Like a Parisian in Style on Avenue de la BourdonnaisExperience Parisian grandeur just steps from the Seine River and the Eiffel Tower. This 400 m² designer residence on the third floor of a classic Haussmann building blends timeless Parisian architecture with modern sophistication. Enjoy the top-half Eiffel Tower view from your living room, surrounded by floor-to-ceiling windows, 4-meter ceilings, and exquisite Italian furnishings.Designed for families and refined travelers who expect more than a hotel suite, this residence offers four king ensuite bedrooms, two elegant living areas, and a fully equipped chef’s kitchen. It’s the perfect sanctuary for those who want to experience authentic Parisian living in absolute comfort.Wake up to sunlight streaming across herringbone floors, dine under the glow of the Tower, and step directly into the city’s most iconic neighborhood — home to world-class boutiques, art museums, and Michelin-starred dining.⸻KEY HIGHLIGHTS✓ Uninterrupted top-half Eiffel Tower View✓ Located on the 3rd floor of a prestigious Haussmann building (with lift access)✓ 400 m² of refined Parisian luxury✓ 4 King Bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom✓ Designer interiors, bespoke Italian furnishings, and 4-meter ceilings✓ Two spacious lounges, including a media lounge with 75-inch Smart TV✓ Elegant dining room for 8 guests with Eiffel Tower backdrop✓ Fully equipped chef’s kitchen wi
